name: Sun, Yi-Fang
source: Sun, Yi-Fang is one of the emigrants escaping from a territory war happening in her hometown. She is very tomboy-ish despite her beautiful body shape. She believes that one day her hometown will be returned to the Chinese people, and then she will be able to live there again.
